post.description: Submit email and password to receive a temporary OTP token. The temp_token expires in 5 minutes.

200.description: OTP required. A temporary token is returned.

errors.description: A detailed description of each field that failed validation.

403.description: Two-factor authentication is not configured on this account.

post.description: Verify the 6-digit OTP code from the authenticator app. Returns a long-lived auth token (30 days).
post.summary: Login (step 2 — OTP)

200.description: Authentication successful. Returns the auth token and basic user info.

422.description: Invalid OTP code or OTP not configured.

errors.description: A detailed description of each field that failed validation.

post.description: Revoke the current auth token. The client must discard the token after this call.
post.summary: Logout

post.description: Rotate the current auth token. The old token is revoked and a fresh 30-day token is issued. Call this before the current token expires to maintain continuous access.
post.summary: Refresh token

200.description: Token rotated successfully. Returns the new token and basic user info.

401.description: No valid token provided or token has expired. Client must re-authenticate.

post.description: Renew the temporary OTP token with a fresh 5-minute TTL. Use this when the previous temp_token is about to expire and the user needs more time to enter the OTP code. Requires the current temp-otp token (not an auth-token).
post.summary: Resend OTP code

200.description: Temp token renewed. A fresh temp_token with 5-minute TTL is returned.

401.description: No valid temp token provided or token has expired. Client must re-authenticate.
